description: This C# source file defines the OpenIdServerConfiguration class, which implements multiple IConfigureOptions interfaces to configure OpenID Connect server options within an OrchardCore module. It sets up endpoints, security credentials, flows, and other server behaviors based on settings retrieved asynchronously from a service.

classes.name: OpenIdServerConfiguration
classes.description: A configuration class for setting up OpenID Connect server options in OrchardCore, implementing multiple IConfigureOptions interfaces to customize authentication, server, data protection, and ASP.NET Core options.

methods.name: Configure (AuthenticationOptions)
methods.description: Configures authentication scheme for OpenID Connect server if settings are valid.

methods.name: Configure (OpenIddictServerOptions)
methods.description: Sets issuer, token encryption, signing credentials, endpoint URIs, supported flows, response types, and caching based on retrieved settings.

methods.name: Configure (OpenIddictServerDataProtectionOptions)
methods.description: Configures token format preference based on settings.

methods.name: Configure (string, OpenIddictServerAspNetCoreOptions)
methods.description: Enables pass-through for various endpoints and disables transport security requirement.

methods.name: Configure (OpenIddictServerAspNetCoreOptions)
methods.description: Infrastructure method that should not be called directly.

methods.name: GetServerSettingsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves and validates server settings, logging warnings if invalid.
